objective: Start a Pokemon Emerald Nuzlocke. Obtain a starter and reach Oldale Town safely.
rules: Catch only the first eligible wild encounter per named area; eligibility begins after receiving Poke Balls.
Fainted Pokemon are permanently retired and must never be used again.

At the first safe PC access, navigate to the last available storage box (Box 14 in Pokemon Emerald), visually verify its position, and rename it GRAVEYARD. Reserve that last box exclusively for dead Pokemon. At the next safe PC access after any faint, deposit the dead Pokemon in GRAVEYARD and visually confirm the transfer; until then keep it out of battle and never revive it. Record each death immediately and track any pending graveyard transfers in memory. Never withdraw or reuse Pokemon from GRAVEYARD. Do not use GRAVEYARD for living Pokemon, including temporarily overleveled Pokemon. If the box is full or a transfer cannot be verified safely, stop and report the issue rather than release a dead Pokemon or use another box. A total party wipe still ends the run immediately, even if transfers are pending.
Do not reload to change an outcome. Stop if the entire usable party faints.
No duplicate or shiny exceptions are enabled in this run.
Use Set battle style. Visually verify and set Battle Style to Set in the Options menu before progressing; do not take free switches offered after knocking out an opponent.

Starters, gift Pokemon, and static encounters share the one-encounter allowance with wild Pokemon for their named area; there are no separate gift or static allowances. The chosen starter consumes its acquisition area's allowance even before receiving Poke Balls. Other gifts consume the allowance when accepted, and eligible static battles consume it when encountered. Determine the acquisition area from visible location or summary information; inspect or stop if it is uncertain. Decline gifts and avoid static encounters in already-used areas.

The first eligible encounter consumes the area's allowance immediately, whether caught or not. Running away, knocking it out, or having it flee forfeits that area's capture; do not retry with another encounter. Wild encounters before receiving Poke Balls do not consume the allowance. Record the encounter and its observed outcome in the ledger, including failed captures.

Evolution is allowed, including evolution using items outside battle. An evolved Pokemon remains the same individual for encounter, nickname, fainting, and level-cap rules; evolution does not grant another encounter or restore eligibility.

Confirm objective completion from visible game evidence before recording success. For a target badge, verify the badge award dialogue or Trainer Card; for Champion victory, verify the victory dialogue, Hall of Fame, or credits. Stop after confirmed completion of the configured objective. Turn limits, interruptions, uncertainty, and a party wipe are not successful completion; stop safely when other rules require it.

Do not use Bag items during battle, including healing items, status cures, PP restoratives, X items, or escape items. Poke Balls are allowed only for eligible Nuzlocke captures. Held items and items used outside battle are allowed; fainted Pokemon must never be revived or reused.

Level caps follow the next undefeated Gym Leader in order: Roxanne 15, Brawly 19, Wattson 24, Flannery 29, Norman 31, Winona 33, Tate & Liza 42, Juan 46. After all eight badges, the Pokemon League entry cap is 58.

Do not intentionally train or bring a Pokemon above the current level cap into battle. An accidentally overleveled Pokemon must be boxed or kept out of battle until a visibly confirmed badge raises the cap enough to make it eligible again; it is not permanently retired.

Check the level cap when starting a Gym Leader battle. Levels gained during that battle are allowed. The League cap is checked once before entering the Elite Four; levels gained during the League are allowed.

Inspect party levels and experience before training or challenging a Gym Leader or the League. Track the current cap, confirmed badges, and temporarily ineligible Pokemon in memory. Leave experience headroom for required battles; avoid optional battles and long action sequences near the cap. If compliance is uncertain, inspect menus or stop before further battle input.
